championshipStep.name: Championship Icarus.step
championshipStep.downloadStatus: Connected provider rejects files over 268,435,456 bytes; source geometry could not be downloaded.

runtimeGeometry.qualification: Official post-Championship AdvantageScope static mesh and five articulated components, matching the final Icarus 2.0 binder appearance. Exact equivalence to the requested 458 MB Championship STEP is unverified.

derivedPadding.reason: Remove source embossed white team numbers so shared game labels are the only number layer.
derivedPadding.approximation: Four plain padding bars measured from the source outline; mechanisms/frame/backer retain original CAD.

redistribution.note: Owner-authorized noncommercial v1 publication; CAD rights review remains pending. The team software license does not establish CAD clearance.

estimates: 66 kg running empty mass includes the source 114.9 lb robot and 17.9 lb bumpers plus an estimated 5.8 kg battery; diagonal inertia is approximate.
51 full-size sphere capacity and simplified volume/tower contact envelope from visible packaging; no independent measured capacity claim.
10.0584 m/s² powered acceleration and grip 1.05 are estimates; source 25 m/s² is a command limit. Optional Icarus-only wheel braking is estimated at 20.1168 m/s² and preserves powered acceleration.
12 shots/s, 38 fuel/s total, 5 rad/s turret response and .28 s feed transit are simulation estimates.
Per-shot angular/speed uncertainty and moving rating .90 are gameplay estimates, not TBA/Statbotics-derived hit probabilities.
limits: Independent real intake selection is coupled to one shared scalar/control; both mouths physically collect and reverse.
Managed dye-rotor feed path, not detailed hook/roller contact physics.
No supported climb profile established for final CAD; disabled despite retained code constants.

Opaque SRPP is faithful to the source; modeled nets are incomplete and the envelope is approximate; decals and small hardware are omitted. The embossed outer foam is replaced by four measured plain padding bars; actual backer/frame/mechanisms remain.
Exact Championship STEP / July GLB geometry equivalence is unverified.
